change: Final M3 RAM-boot polish following v5.6.4 physical hardware verification (zero panic, stale VLAN 7 closed, FLOWOFFLOAD active, block_relay=0 + PC-to-5G ping 7ms, WEXT frequency/bitrate/txpower/operstate UP, LuCI login, 27.4 MiB free RAM, 0 UART n=512 noise): (1) enable TX A-MPDU Block-Ack (ampdu=1) and Short GI (shortGI20M=1, shortGI40M=1, shortGI80M=1 on 5 GHz) in rtl8192cd.sh — fixing both wlan0 (previously AMSDU-only LGI) and wlan1 (previously AGGRE_MTHD_NONE LGI); (2) fix regulatory country handling (rtl_country_to_regdomain aligned to 8192cd_11h.c countryIEArray + rtl_emit_country emitting countrystr and country2reg=1/0) so non-US countries (VN/CN/TW/JP/EU/00) are never silently overwritten back to US by map_country_to_reg(); (3) fix rtl_giwencode() WPA2 branch (erq->length = 16; memset(key, 0, 16); IW_ENCODE_NOKEY) so iwconfig displays masked encryption instead of off; (4) fix rsd0614-survey BusyBox tr class bug (\040-\176), add non-64K cr6c-end + 4KiB read-only mtd2ro scanner for M4 geometry discovery, show uhttpd ps args, radio0 factory RF dmesg, iwpriv ampdu/shortGI/country MIBs, br-lan multicast_to_unicast, and gpio-button-hotplug status; all 6 MTDs stay read-only, pcie1/LEDs disabled, persistent flash NO-GO
